data.long_meaning: A young girl, a damsel in distress, a tender and delicate flower. Parents who choose Neekdokht usually hope their child will grow to embody young girl and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Neekdokht" holds a significant cultural impact as it is a term used to refer to a young girl in the Persian language. In Iranian and Persian culture, girls are often treasured and pampered with utmost care due to their perceived vulnerability and gentleness. The name "Neekdokht" symbolizes the tender and delicate nature of a young girl, emphasizing her need for protection, nurturing, and loving care.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Neekdokht" can symbolize the innocence and purity of a child in the eyes of God. In Islamic teachings, children are seen as a gift from Allah and are valued highly. The name can serve as a reminder of the importance of nurturing and protecting our children spiritually, as well as emotionally and physically, so that they may grow up to be righteous and devout servants of Allah.
